app_purpose: Java asynchronous event-driven network framework; io.netty netty-codec-http is a widely embedded HTTP/1.1 codec used as an origin server and behind proxies -> request-smuggling surface

v0.ref: io.netty:netty-codec-http:4.1.41.Final. HttpObjectDecoder.splitHeader(): `for (nameEnd=nameStart; ...) { char ch = sb.charAtUnsafe(nameEnd); if (ch == ':' || Character.isWhitespace(ch)) break; }`. A whitespace before the colon breaks the header-name loop, so 'Transfer-Encoding : chunked' is read as a VALID Transfer-Encoding: chunked -> pre-CVE-2019-16869.
v0.image: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-8 build of a tiny unmodified Netty server (Maven-resolved netty-codec-http 4.1.41.Final)

v1.ref: io.netty:netty-codec-http:4.1.43.Final. splitHeader() CVE-2019-16869 fix (PR #9585, commit 39cafcb): for requests whitespace no longer breaks the name loop -> `if (ch == ':' || (!isDecodingRequest() && Character.isWhitespace(ch))) break;` so 'Transfer-Encoding :' keeps the SP in the name and DefaultHttpHeaders rejects it. INCOMPLETE: readHeaders() still accepts a request with BOTH Content-Length AND Transfer-Encoding: chunked (chunked silently overrides CL, no error) -> CVE-2020-7238 CL.TE smuggling remains.
v1.image: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-8 build of a tiny unmodified Netty server (Maven-resolved netty-codec-http 4.1.43.Final)

v2.ref: io.netty:netty-codec-http:4.1.44.Final. readHeaders() CVE-2020-7238 fix (PR #9865, commit 8494b04): rejects multiple Content-Length and CL+Transfer-Encoding:chunked for HTTP/1.1 -> `throw new IllegalArgumentException("Both 'Content-Length: " + contentLength + "' and 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' found")`. Closes the residual; the whitespace-before-colon rejection from CVE-2019-16869 is also still present.
v2.image: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-8 build of a tiny unmodified Netty server (Maven-resolved netty-codec-http 4.1.44.Final)
